sampling: last recorded servo tick at or before each 30 Hz display time; nearest landmark receipt to last_landmarks_received_monotonic_s
matching: same-host monotonic reception times, not exposure synchronization
limitations: MuJoCo playback of recorded measured joint angles, not raw Hybrid targets, new physical execution or proof of contact accuracy.
selection_basis: bounded search for pinch/open cycle, no tracking loss, low recorded angular steps, then visual inspection; not an exhaustive optimum
